decisions.rationale: Charizard Mega Y sets sun and Heat Wave hits both Whimsicott (2x) and Metagross (2x) super effectively. Hawlucha (187 Spe) outspeeds all foes; Acrobatics 2HKOs Whimsicott through Sash. Krookodile Intimidate weakens Metagross, EQ is 2x. Sinistcha provides sustain and redirection vs non-Grass threats. Plan: turn 1 Heat Wave + Acrobatics on Whimsicott to break Sash and KO, then clean up.

Bring Whimsicott/Mega Metagross with Mega Metagross intended. Turn one, Whimsicott supplies Tailwind or disruption while Metagross immediately pressures the revealed Hydreigon/Krookodile mode. Rotom-Wash is the needed Charizard answer; Arcanine gives Intimidate, Snarl, and a physical backstop against Krookodile/Hawlucha.
decisions.notebook: Opponent game-1 mode omitted Sinistcha/Sableye and used Hydreigon, Krookodile, Charizard-Y, Hawlucha. Charizard-Y repeatedly used Protect; preserve Whimsicott Encore pressure when possible. Krookodile is Jolly Intimidate Sitrus with Earthquake/Knock Off/Close Combat/Protect; Hydreigon is Timid Life Orb; Hawlucha is Jolly White Herb Unburden. Expect possible game-2 pivot to Charizard-Y + Sinistcha redirection or Sableye disruption.

decisions.rationale: Prankster Tailwind is unstoppable turn 1. Hawlucha at 187 Speed outspeeds both foes but Zen Headbutt OHKO risk (82.7-141.2%) is too high to ignore—Protect keeps Hawlucha safe. Charizard Mega Evolves for sun, Heat Wave breaks Whimsicott Sash and threatens Metagross (73.8-136.1%). Accept Tailwind; Hawlucha preserved for Unburden sweep later. Down 0-1, consistency > gamble.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opponent leads Whimsicott (Focus Sash, Prankster Tailwind/Encore/Taunt/Moonblast) + Metagross-Mega (Jolly, Zen Headbutt/Hammer Arm). Back line: Farigiraf (Armor Tail, Trick Room), Rotom-W (Wacan), Arcanine (Intimidate, Lum), Altaria (Cloud Nine, Leftovers). My team: Charizard-Mega-Y, Hawlucha, Krookodile, Sinistcha. Whimsicott always Prankster Tailwinds T1—no answer without Prankster Taunt. Farigiraf blocks Prankster with Armor Tail but also sets Trick Room. Altaria Cloud Nine removes sun. Krookodile Intimidate cycling helps vs Metagross. Sinistcha Rage Powder for redirect, Strength Sap for recovery. Metagross-Mega Zen Headbutt OHKO range on Hawlucha.

decisions.rationale: Prankster Tailwind establishes speed control before either foe attacks, while Mega Protect prevents the immediate sun-boosted Fire pressure and preserves Metagross to threaten Hawlucha next turn. Whimsicott retains Sash and Encore pressure against Charizard Protect.
decisions.notebook: Opponent game-1 mode used Hydreigon, Krookodile, Charizard-Y, Hawlucha; Charizard-Y repeatedly used Protect. Krookodile is Jolly Intimidate Sitrus with Earthquake/Knock Off/Close Combat/Protect; Hydreigon is Timid Life Orb; Hawlucha is Jolly White Herb Unburden. Charizard-Y + Hawlucha lead confirmed game 2. Preserve Whimsicott Encore pressure on Charizard Protect; Tailwind enables Mega Metagross to pressure Hawlucha.

decisions.rationale: Heat Wave OHKOs Whimsicott through sash and spread; Acrobatics guarantees the KO if Heat Wave misses (90% acc). Whimsicott moves first and will likely Encore Charizard, but Heat Wave is strong in sun. Hawlucha may fall to Zen Headbutt, but Krookodile's Intimidate comes in next turn. Against Protect+Acrobatics, they can double-target Hawlucha with Moonblast+Zen Headbutt for guaranteed KO and still lose Whimsicott.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opponent leads Whimsicott (Sash/Prankster Tailwind/Encore/Taunt/Moonblast) + Metagross-Mega (Jolly, Zen Headbutt/Hammer Arm). Rotom-W (Wacan), Arcanine (Intimidate/Lum), Altaria (Cloud Nine/Leftovers). My Krookodile Intimidate cycling helps vs Metagross. Sinistcha Rage Powder redirects. Metagross Zen Headbutt nearly always OHKOs Hawlucha.

decisions.rationale: Encore locks Charizard into its revealed Heat Wave before Metagross switches. Rotom resists Fire, while Hawlucha can only remove Whimsicott this turn; Arcanine can then enter with Intimidate and Metagross is preserved for the endgame. This avoids leaving Metagross exposed to sun-boosted Heat Wave or relying on consecutive Protect.
decisions.notebook: Opponent game-1 mode used Hydreigon, Krookodile, Charizard-Y, Hawlucha; Charizard-Y repeatedly used Protect. Krookodile is Jolly Intimidate Sitrus with Earthquake/Knock Off/Close Combat/Protect; Hydreigon is Timid Life Orb; Hawlucha is Jolly White Herb Unburden. Charizard-Y + Hawlucha lead confirmed game 2. Preserve Whimsicott Encore pressure on Charizard Protect or revealed Heat Wave; Tailwind enables Mega Metagross to pressure Hawlucha.

decisions.rationale: Bring Arcanine. It resists Charizard's currently Encore-locked Heat Wave and Intimidate immediately cuts Hawlucha’s physical damage. Mega Metagross would enter directly into two likely super-effective attacks, whereas Arcanine preserves Rotom and gives the safer next-turn positioning.

Preserve Tailwind-enabled Metagross positioning where possible; Arcanine Intimidate is valuable into Hawlucha/Krookodile physical lines.

decisions.rationale: Charizard Encored into resisted Heat Wave vs both foes—dead weight for 2 turns. Hawlucha at serious OHKO risk from Thunderbolt/Flare Blitz. Switch to Krookodile grabs Intimidate and preserves Zard for Metagross; Hawlucha Protect scouts safely. Next turn Krook EQ (Hawlucha immune) + Hawlucha CC threatens clean KOs with Tailwind fading.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Whimsicott Prankster Tailwind T1, Encore T2. Arcanine Careful/Lum with FlareBlitz/Snarl/WillOWisp/Protect; Intimidate cycling helps. Hawlucha otherwise acts before Rotom and can deny its attack. Charizard is Encore-locked to Heat Wave unless it switches; either outcome favors removing Hawlucha.

decisions.rationale: Hawlucha outspeeds both foes and OHKOs Rotom with Close Combat, removing the TBolt threat. EQ from Krookodile hits Arcanine hard (56–104%) and misses Hawlucha (Flying) and Rotom (Levitate). If Rotom Protects (33%), Hawlucha loses some momentum but Arcanine still takes EQ damage; Tailwind expires next turn, giving Krookodile the speed edge.
decisions.notebook: Game 2, score 0-1. Opponent: Whimsicott (fainted), Arcanine Careful/Lum FlareBlitz Snarl WoW Protect, Rotom-W Modest/Wacan Thunderbolt HydroPump WoW Protect (Protect used last turn), Metagross Jolly ZenHeadbutt HammerArm MeteorMash Protect. Tailwind expires after this turn. Plan: eliminate Rotom now, preserve Charizard-Y + Sinistcha for endgame vs Metagross. Sun advantage critical; avoid switching Charizard into Metagross prematurely.

Protect preserves Arcanine through the immediate physical double-target pressure while Rotom takes the only available super-effective shot at Krookodile before Tailwind ends.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Hawlucha moves first at 374 speed, guaranteeing CC on Metagross. Combined with EQ on both foes: Metagross takes 63.1-107.1%, Arcanine 55.8-103.6%. Even if Metagross retaliates and KOs one mon, the other completes the attack. Opponent has no bench—one KO likely ends the game. Arcanine's Protect is at reduced rate from consecutive use, so double Protect is unlikely.
decisions.notebook: Game 2, score 0-1. Opponent Whimsicott/Arcanine/Rotom-W/Metagross. Whimsicott (Sash consumed) and Rotom-W (Wacan) fainted. Arcanine Careful/Lum: FlareBlitz/Snarl/WillOWisp/Protect. Metagross Jolly: MeteorMash/ZenHeadbutt/HammerArm/Protect. No bench remaining—KO both to win. Tailwind expired. Sun expires after this turn. Preserve Charizard-Y + Sinistcha for cleanup if needed.

decisions.rationale: Hawlucha is guaranteed faster under Unburden and threatens Metagross-Mega with Close Combat, while Krookodile threatens Arcanine with Earthquake. Protect preserves the essential Mega against the immediate double-target line; Flare Blitz is the only available direct pressure on Hawlucha if Krookodile chooses a non-Earthquake line or Hawlucha does not Protect.

Preserve Mega Metagross where possible; Arcanine Intimidate remains valuable into Hawlucha/Krookodile physical lines.

decisions.rationale: Hawlucha is fastest and guarantees Close Combat (24.6-42.6%) before any foe action. Krookodile Earthquake adds 38.5-64.5% spread damage; Hawlucha is immune. Combined range 63.1-107.1% rolls to KO. Even if Metagross KOs Krookodile with Hammer Arm first, Charizard enters, Drought activates, and Heat Wave in Sun (73.3-149%) seals the game. No Protect risk outweighs losing tempo with a switch.
decisions.notebook: Game 2, score 0-1. Opponent Whimsicott/Arcanine/Rotom-W/Metagross. Whimsicott Sash consumed, Timid Prankster with Tailwind/Taunt/Moonblast/Encore. Farigiraf (Sassy/Sitrus/ArmorTail) and Altaria (Calm/Leftovers/CloudNine) not brought game 2. Metagross Protect used turn 5, reduced success next use.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Both Hawlucha and Krookodile have immediate guaranteed KO attacks, and Hawlucha acts first. Attacking cannot prevent a KO this turn; reduced-success Protect is the only line that can preserve Metagross and retain any winning chance.

Hawlucha at 374 Speed is fastest; Protect guarantees it survives any hit. Krookodile Knock Off with 1.5x item boost easily KOs 3% Metagross. Even if Metagross Protects, we reset safely. No need to risk a double Protect or Hammer Arm OHKO on Krookodile. This guarantees the game and series win.
decisions.notebook: Game 2, up 1-0. Opponent brought Whimsicott/Arcanine/Rotom-W/Metagross. Whimsicott Timid Prankster with Tailwind/Taunt/Moonblast/Encore, Focus Sash consumed. Metagross Protect used turns 5 (success) and 6 (fail). Farigiraf (Sassy/ArmorTail/TrickRoom) and Altaria (Calm/CloudNine/Tailwind) not brought. Opponent tends to Protect predictably when cornered.

decisions.rationale: Metagross cannot act before Unburden Hawlucha, and either Close Combat or Krookodile Earthquake removes it. Protect is the only line that can prevent an immediate KO from both foes, preserving the sole nonzero continuation chance despite its repeated-use risk.

Hawlucha is guaranteed fastest and Acrobatics KOs 3% Metagross even NVE. Krookodile Knock Off is backup if Hawlucha somehow misses or Metagross Protects (25% chance). With no enemy bench, any Metagross counterattack after a successful Protect only delays; Krookodile or backline Charizard/Sinistcha clean up next turn.

Hammer Arm is the best miss-punish: Metagross acts before Krookodile and has a super-effective hit into its full-health attacker. Reduced-rate Protect does not create a sustainable win condition.

reflections.summary: Opponent's over-reliance on Protect with Metagross (turns 5–7) led to a failed Protect, leaving it at 3% and allowing a clean KO. Their Arcanine sacrifice on turn 5 also failed to turn the tide, while our sustained offensive pressure with Krookodile and Hawlucha exploited their passive play.
reflections.adjustment: In Game 3, anticipate less predictable Protect usage. Use Taunt from Hawlucha more aggressively to prevent Protect stalling, and be prepared for the opponent to bring Farigiraf (Trick Room) or Altaria (Cloud Nine) to disrupt our speed and weather. Consider double-targeting into potential Protects or leading with disruption against expected leads.
reflections.notebook: Opponent habit: heavy Protect reliance when cornered (Metagross protected consecutively). Arcanine willing to sacrifice with Flare Blitz into Fighting-types despite Intimidate. Farigiraf (Sassy, Trick Room, Armor Tail) and Altaria (Calm, Cloud Nine, Tailwind) remain unplayed in series; likely to appear in G3 to counter our fast, sun-based offense. Whimsicott's Focus Sash already consumed in G2. Plan for G3: fast pressure with Hawlucha/Krookodile, but bring Taunt to block Trick Room and consider preserving Charizard-Y to re-set sun if Altaria switches in.

reflections.summary: Lost to the Charizard-Y/Hawlucha/Krookodile physical-pressure mode: Rotom and Arcanine fell, leaving Mega Metagross repeatedly forced to Protect against Close Combat and Earthquake before Hawlucha finished it. The four-Pokémon/Mega Metagross plan was poorly positioned into Krookodile’s Ground pressure plus Hawlucha’s Unburden speed.
reflections.adjustment: Do not center the rematch plan on Mega Metagross into this mode; prioritize preserving Rotom and using Whimsicott disruption/Tailwind to deny Hawlucha-Krookodile tempo before committing Metagross.
reflections.notebook: Opponent’s Charizard-Y + Hawlucha lead is confirmed. Hawlucha is Jolly White Herb Unburden with Acrobatics/Close Combat/Taunt/Protect and becomes decisively faster after item activation; respect immediate Close Combat pressure. Krookodile is Jolly Intimidate Sitrus with Earthquake/Knock Off/Close Combat/Protect, creating a strong Ground-pressure partner for Hawlucha. Charizard-Y has Heat Wave/Solar Beam/Scorching Sands/Protect. Sableye revealed Prankster Will-O-Wisp/Taunt/Knock Off/Recover; Sinistcha revealed Matcha Gotcha/Rage Powder/Strength Sap/Protect. Future plan: avoid relying on Mega Metagross as the primary answer to the Hawlucha-Krookodile mode; preserve Rotom and establish speed control/disruption early.
